title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Form No. 22] REPORT ON TAXABLE-GOODS MANUFACTURING BUSINESS [ ] Commencement [ ] Change [ ] Closure ※ Read the instructions on the reverse side before completing this form, and place a √ in the applicable box. Receipt No.: ____________________ Receipt Date: ____________________ Processing Period: Immediate Taxpayer - Name (Representative): ______________________________________ - Business Registration No. (Resident Registration No.): ______________________________ - Trade Name (Corporate Name): ______________________________________ - Telephone No.: ______________________________ - Address (Location of Head Office): _________________________________________________ - Location of Manufacturing Place: __________________________________________________ Details of Report - Taxable Item Type: __________________________________________ - Product Name: ______________________________________________ - Date of Commencement / Closure: ______ year ______ month ______ day - Whether Application for Business-Operator Unit Taxation Has Been Filed: [ ] Yes [ ] No Pursuant to Article 18 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act, I hereby file the above report. Date: ______ year ______ month ______ day Applicant: ______________________________ (Signature or Seal) To: Head of the Tax Office Documents to Be Submitted by Applicant - One copy of the business authorization / permission certificate (only where the applicant operates a business requiring authorization or permission under applicable statutes) Fee: None Matters to Be Confirmed by the Responsible Public Official 1. Extract from the resident registration record: where the person concerned files in person, presentation of an identification document such as a resident registration card substitutes for the extract. 2. Certificate of corporate registration particulars (only where the applicant is a corporation). CONSENT TO JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION I consent to the responsible public official’s confirmation of the extract from the resident registration record through the joint use of administrative information under Article 36 of the Electronic Government Act. If I do not consent, I understand that I must directly submit the relevant document. Applicant: ______________________________ (Signature or Seal) Paper: 210mm × 297mm, general paper 60g/㎡ (recycled) ■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Schedule to Attached Form No. 22] STATEMENT OF SUBORDINATE BUSINESS PLACES OF AN APPLICANT FOR BUSINESS-OPERATOR UNIT TAXATION

Instructions 1. When applying for business-operator unit taxation for the first time, list all subordinate business places and write “New” in the Remarks column. 2. When commencing a subordinate business place, resuming business after suspension, closing it, or suspending it, enter the applicable commencement date (or date of resumption) or closure date (or date of suspension), and state “Commencement” (“Resumption”) or “Closure” (“Suspension”) in the Remarks column. 3. When relocating a subordinate business place, separately report the former business place as “Closure” and the new business place as “Commencement.” [Source-structure note: Preserve all three commencement/change/closure checkboxes; the Yes/No business-operator unit-taxation field; the conditional authorization/permission document; both official-confirmation items; the administrative-information consent and refusal alternative; and all eight numbered blank subordinate-business-place records. The main form is revised Mar. 19, 2018, while the attached table is an Apr. 1, 2011 established form; both are part of this single frozen source unit.]
